items.title: Buddy DeFranco interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 13, 1996
items.q: The last one was “Chip Off the Old Block” that I did for Concord. Carl Jefferson suggested I do another album pretty soon

ctx.x: Are you working with any particular record label right now?

Not right now. The last one was “Chip Off the Old Block” that I did for Concord. Carl Jefferson suggested I do another album pretty soon, unfortunately Carl is gone, so I don’t know, that’s in limbo. I did an album recently with Al Raymond’s band, a big band in Philadelphia, some nice stuff in there. I’ve done a lot of recording activities. Many re- issues as well as what I’ve done recently. Many re-issues.
